claims.text: Mount Everest is Earth's highest mountain above sea level.
Mount Everest lies on the border between Nepal and China.
Mount Everest is part of the Himalayas.
The official height of Mount Everest is 8,848.86 metres.
Tenzing Norgay and Edmund Hillary made the first documented ascent of Everest in 1953.

lies.text: Tenzing Norgay and Edmund Hillary made the first documented ascent of Everest in 1963.

adds.text: Mount Everest is known as Sagarmatha in Nepal.
